key_insight: An LLM agent rescued failed spectral analyses through bounded fitting adjustments while leaving quantitative property extraction to deterministic code.
engineering_relevance: Autonomous exception handling can make self-driving laboratories more robust by recovering defensible measurements and withholding unsupported values.
method: Run a predefined numerical routine to extract Urbach energy from optical transmittance spectra.
Use an LLM agent to assess spectra and fitting diagnostics, accepting valid results unchanged.
Adjust predefined fitting parameters within bounds for recoverable failures; return NaN when evidence is insufficient.
evidence_signal: Across 203 epitaxial β-Ga2O3 film spectra, the agent retained 183 baseline values, recovered 16 of 20 failures, and returned NaN for 4.
watch_item: Evaluation covered one material system and analysis workflow; broader reliability remains to be established.
paper_title: Autonomous adaptive spectral analysis with an LLM agent for self-driving laboratories
